Question:
A game board consists of \(64\) squares that alternate between shaded and unshaded. The figure below shows square \(P\) in the bottom row and square \(Q\) in the top row. A marker is placed at \(P.\) A step consists of moving the marker onto one of the adjoining unshaded squares in the row above. How many \(7\)-step paths are there from \(P\) to \(Q?\) (The figure shows a sample path.)
